jobs.description:
Low workload at night and a bit more activity during the day? That’s the life of a shuttle driver—specifically, a driver with a T or C license. I can hear you thinking: "A T-license?" 🤔 Yes, you got that for free with your B-license if you obtained it before July 2015. No experience yet? No problem at all. All this with a starting hourly wage of €17! 😱🤑

What we offer
- Basic hourly wage of €17 per hour
- Permanent position after 3 months
- Fee of 35%, 50% or 100% for evening and weekends
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer
- 5-shift schedule, always have 4 days off
- Plenty of colleagues around during the day

Who you are
As a shuttle driver, you naturally possess the following:

- Willingness to work a 5-shift schedule: 2 morning shifts, 2 evening shifts, 2 night shifts, followed by 4 days off!
- A valid Category B & T driving license! (This is a MUST)\
- Proficiency in Dutch or English

What will you do
You’ll be trained by an experienced driver. 🚛 You’ll get to know the distribution center step by step; there are nine locations you’ll be shuttling between—for instance, driving from Hall A to B or from D to F. You act as a vital link connecting all the halls. It’s busier during the day, so you’ll be moving from one task to the next, whereas at night, you might even have time to lend a hand in the warehouse. That makes for a really varied job, doesn't it? 💪🏼

Where will you work
The friendly company you’ll be working for is Kuehne+Nagel, a global transport and logistics firm. In Veghel, you’ll be working for major names; Mars, Unilever, and Nestlé are three of Kuehne+Nagel’s big clients. 🍫🧋 Isn't it great to be able to contribute to this?
